notes: Moisture values are soil moisture percentages as reported by common capacitive soil sensors. min_moisture is when the plant should be watered; max_moisture is the wettest it should stay. water_ml is a typical drink for a plant in a 15-20 cm pot. All values are starting points and can be overridden per plant.

plants.name: Houseplant (generic)
plants.care: Water when the top few centimetres of soil are dry.

plants.name: Monstera
plants.care: Let the top third of the soil dry out between drinks.

plants.name: Golden Pothos
plants.care: Tolerates drying out; droops when thirsty and perks up after watering.

plants.name: Heartleaf Philodendron
plants.care: Water when the top half of the soil is dry.

plants.name: String of Pearls
plants.care: Succulent: let the soil dry almost completely.

plants.name: Snake Plant
plants.care: Let the soil dry completely; overwatering is the main risk.

plants.name: Dracaena
plants.care: Water when the top half of the soil is dry. Sensitive to fluoride.

plants.name: ZZ Plant
plants.care: Stores water in its rhizomes; let it dry out fully.

plants.name: Spider Plant
plants.care: Keep lightly moist; brown tips mean it got too dry.

plants.name: Peace Lily
plants.care: Likes evenly moist soil; wilts dramatically when dry.

plants.name: Anthurium
plants.care: Water when the top few centimetres are dry; likes humidity.

plants.name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
plants.care: Water thoroughly when the top 5 cm are dry; hates being moved.

plants.name: Rubber Plant
plants.care: Water when the top half of the soil is dry.

plants.name: Weeping Fig
plants.care: Keep evenly moist; drops leaves when stressed.

plants.name: Bird of Paradise
plants.care: Water when the top 5 cm are dry; drinks more in summer.

plants.name: Boston Fern
plants.care: Keep consistently moist and humid; never let it dry out.

plants.name: Maidenhair Fern
plants.care: Very thirsty; crisps quickly if the soil dries.

plants.name: Bird's Nest Fern
plants.care: Keep moist; water around the rosette, not into it.

plants.name: Kentia Palm
plants.care: Water when the top few centimetres are dry.

plants.name: Parlour Palm
plants.care: Keep lightly moist, never soggy.

plants.name: Areca Palm
plants.care: Keep evenly moist in the warmer months.

plants.name: Calathea
plants.care: Keep evenly moist; leaves curl when thirsty. Prefers filtered water.

plants.name: Prayer Plant
plants.care: Keep lightly moist and humid.

plants.name: Chinese Evergreen
plants.care: Water when the top half of the soil is dry.

plants.name: Dumb Cane
plants.care: Keep lightly moist; sap is toxic to pets.

plants.name: Aloe Vera
plants.care: Water deeply, then let it dry out completely.

plants.name: Jade Plant
plants.care: Let the soil dry fully; water less in winter.

plants.name: Echeveria
plants.care: Soak and dry; keep water off the rosette.

plants.name: Cactus
plants.care: Water sparingly; almost none in winter.

plants.name: Moth Orchid
plants.care: Water when the bark is dry and roots look silvery.

plants.name: African Violet
plants.care: Keep lightly moist; water from below and keep leaves dry.

plants.name: Begonia
plants.care: Water when the top few centimetres are dry; avoid soggy soil.

plants.name: Basil
plants.care: Keep consistently moist; pinch out flowers.

plants.name: Mint
plants.care: Thirsty; never let it dry out.

plants.name: Parsley
plants.care: Keep evenly moist.

plants.name: Rosemary
plants.care: Let the soil dry between drinks; dislikes wet roots.
